title: EC3: entitlement, triumph & betrayal
summary: Dixie Carter’s on-screen nephew builds an unbeaten reputation and captures the world title. Matt Hardy’s ruthless turn then costs EC3 both the championship and the protection of Tyrus.

chapters.title: EC3 defeats the Olympic champion
chapters.result: EC3 defeats Kurt Angle to win his first TNA world title.
chapters.context: The undefeated contender converts his protected status into a win over the company’s established main-event standard. The date is the television broadcast.

chapters.title: Hardy and Tyrus turn the tables
chapters.result: Matt Hardy defeats EC3 in Last Man Standing to win the world title.
chapters.context: Tyrus switches allegiance as Hardy embraces a ruthless persona. EC3 becomes the wronged former champion rather than the privileged antagonist.
